'''Società Sportiva Cosmos''' is a [[San Marino|Sammarinese]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club, based in [[Serravalle (San Marino)|Serravalle]] and founded in 1979. Cosmos currently plays in ''Girone A'' of [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio]]. The team's colors are green and yellow.
The club is named after the [[New York Cosmos (1971–1985)|New York Cosmos]] team."}}
